turns.user: Under the Elevation heading in terrain.Rmd, add a chunk that plots the elev raster and a sentence giving its mean elevation.

graders.app_state: (() => { const t = s.tabs.find(t => t.fileName === 'terrain.Rmd'); if (!t) return false; const c = t.content; const h = c.indexOf('## Elevation'); if (h < 0) return false; const after = c.slice(h); const hasChunk = /```\{r[^}]*\}[\s\S]*?plot\s*\(/.test(after); const chunks = (after.match(/```\{r[^}]*\}[\s\S]*?```/g) || []).join('\n'); const inline = /`r [^`]+`/.test(after); const computed = inline || /\b(global|mean)\s*\(/.test(chunks); return hasChunk && computed && /mean/i.test(after); })()
